simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תְּנוּאָה (H8569) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: תְּנוּאָה (tᵉnûwʼâh) means alienation ; by implication, enmity First listed occurrence: Job 33 10.

definitions.full: H8569. tenuah [ תְּנוּאָה ] noun feminine opposition ; — suffix תְּנוּאָתִיּ Num 14:34 my opposition , of ׳י ; plural יִמְצָא עָלַי תְּנוּאוֺת Job 33:10 = occasions, for hostility (|| count as enemy).
